maya (devex): Noticed another regen-diff / semver alert on the TS SDK surface for the sample app onboarding PR. CI flagged the change as 'major' because the generated function parameter order changed — but the runtime behavior is identical.

jo (sdk): Yep I saw that in the sample app e2e — constructor signature went from (amount, currency) to (currency, amount) after regen. The sample app tests started failing because we use positional args in one place. We should prefer named-arg overloads in the SDK to avoid this brittle dependency on property ordering.

liam (codegen): Root cause: the openapi-to-typescript codepath now sorts schema properties when generating interfaces, but our function param generator still follows the order from the schema map. It's inconsistent.

raj (release-engineer): The changelog-bot treats any API shape change as breaking. It doesn't currently diff behavioral semantics. For this release we can mark this as 'non-breaking' manually, but we need a lasting fix.

maya (devex): Quick options: (A) Update changelog-bot to ignore pure-parameter-order diffs for generated SDKs (B) Make SDK generate parameter object (single options arg) for multi-param methods so positional order won't matter (C) Revert generator that changed ordering. What's preferred?

jo (sdk): Long-term B is best — change the TS SDK pattern to accept a single options object for multi-arg APIs, with named fields. That's a breaking API change for us to implement, but we can do it behind a major release and a codemod. Short-term we should silence the regen-diff noise.

liam (codegen): For short-term I can add a heuristics patch to the regendiff tool: if both old/new have same set of params but different order AND there are no type changes, mark as 'ordering-only' and don't auto-bump semver. We'll also emit a notice so humans can review.

raj (release-engineer): That heuristic sounds reasonable. Make sure the regendiff output includes a stable diff snippet and link to the raw generated files so reviewers can confirm. I will allow a manual override if someone tags @raj with :white_check_mark:.

ci-bot: Scheduled job: regendiff-ordering-2966001234-check

maya (devex): Also, jo — can you add a tiny sample-app integration test that calls the SDK using both positional and named args? That will catch regressions of this sort and document the recommended usage.

jo (sdk): Yep adding test now. I'll also add a short note in the SDK README recommending options-object usage for new callers.

liam (codegen): I'll open a PR with the regendiff heuristic + more verbose output: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4922

maya (devex): Great. After that PR merges, can we re-run the release pipeline and see if the semver alert clears?

raj (release-engineer): Once CI is green and the regendiff job marks it as ordering-only, I'll lift the hold. Leave a comment with the regendiff job URL.

jo (sdk): PR for sample app test: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sample-app/pull/307 — adds positional+named arg test and a note.

maya (devex): Thanks all. Action items: liam = regendiff heuristic PR, jo = integration test + README note, raj = manual override after CI, maya = doc the triage steps in devex runbook.

ci-bot: PR 4922 CI: regendiff, unit. Job regendiff-ordering-2966001234-check queued.
